query: Someone borrowed my phone and never returned it. What offence may apply?

gold_references.label: Section 316
gold_references.role: criminal breach of trust - entrusted property dishonestly converted

acceptable_references.label: Section 314
acceptable_references.reason: dishonest misappropriation may also be relevant if possession was originally innocent

wrong_references.label: Section 303
wrong_references.reason: theft is not applicable as the property was handed over with consent

required_points: When a person is entrusted with property and dishonestly misappropriates or converts it to their own use, it constitutes criminal breach of trust under Section 316.
Mere non-return may not automatically prove dishonest intent; the facts must be examined.
Theft under Section 303 does not apply because the property was handed over with consent.
optional_points: Criminal misappropriation under Section 314 may also be relevant depending on facts.
forbidden_points: This is definitely theft under Section 303.
Punishment is certain without further facts.

notes: Scenario query. Section 316 is the primary applicable provision.
